paper_id: Liu et al. - 2014 - Generic Composite Counting in RFID Systems
title: Generic Composite Counting in RFID Systems
motivation: 现有RFID计数协议只支持单reader或union场景,无法处理intersection/difference等复合集表达式,实际应用需求无法满足
problem_framing: 定义复合集计数问题:给定任意集合表达式E(如(S₁∪S₂)-(S₃∩S₄)),估计|E|的基数
key_insight: 用小规模synopsis代替完整tag集,通过hash值排序和Jaccard相似度分解,实现任意集合表达式的概率估计
method_signature: 基于slotted ALOHA的synopsis收集协议,使用binary search提取k个最小hash值,O(k log n)通信开销
evaluation_criteria: 时间效率(通信slot数/耗时)和(ε,δ)-精度保证下的相对误差<10%
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 原型系统因USRP-WISP通信距离限制无法做大规模实验,只能用simulation验证
evidence_for_taste: most existing protocols, however, only apply
cannot be trivially solved by simple counting
the overhead of exact counting is prohibitively high
It is obviously incorrect to approximate
communication cost is within a small factor from the optimal
thinking_moves: 将具体应用场景(warehouse/conference/authentication)抽象为集合代数问题
利用communication complexity理论证明下界,用reduction桥接RFID与Two-party模型
将集合操作问题分解为union基数估计和Jaccard相似度估计的组合
hash函数将任意分布ID映射为均匀分布,使order statistics可直接应用
将近似计算的理论保证转换为具体参数k的选择(Θ(1/ε²ln(1/δ)))
用synopsis交集大小直接估计比例R=|E|/|∪Si|,绕过原始ID未知难题
